lead.titleZh: 本体感觉训练预防运动员踝关节扭伤，证据等级高
lead.titleEn: Proprioceptive training for ankle sprain prevention in athletes: high-level evidence
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 9 条更新，涵盖 5 个专业方向。最值得关注的是运动康复领域，一篇 88 分的系统综述证实本体感觉训练对预防运动员踝关节扭伤的有效性，为临床实践提供了强有力支持。此外，神经康复与骨科方向也有高分观察研究与RCT值得留意。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's update includes 9 items across 5 specialties. The most noteworthy is in sports rehabilitation, where an 88-score systematic review confirms the effectiveness of proprioceptive training in preventing ankle sprains in athletes, offering strong clinical guidance. High-scoring observational studies and RCTs in neurorehabilitation and orthopedics are also worth attention.

items.title: Effects of 12-week massage on pain, muscle co-contraction, and knee loading in medial knee osteoarthritis: a randomized clinical trial
items.summary: A 12-week massage therapy RCT in 56 medial knee OA patients showed greater improvements in WOMAC pain, stiffness, physical function, and reduced medial muscle co-contraction compared to healthcare education.
items.curatedReason: 针对56名内侧膝骨关节炎（OA）患者的RCT显示，12周按摩治疗显著改善了WOMAC疼痛、僵硬和身体功能，并减少内侧肌肉协同收缩。虽然未影响膝关节负荷或步速，但其结果支持将按摩作为膝OA症状和神经肌肉功能的有效辅助治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 12周按摩对内侧膝骨关节炎患者疼痛、肌肉协同收缩和膝关节负荷的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.titleEn: Effects of 12-week massage on pain, muscle co-contraction, and knee loading in medial knee osteoarthritis: a randomized clinical trial
items.summaryZh: 一项针对56名内侧膝骨关节炎患者的12周按摩随机对照试验显示，与医疗健康教育相比，按摩在WOMAC疼痛、僵硬、身体功能方面有更大改善，并减少了内侧肌肉协同收缩。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT of 56 medial knee OA patients shows 12 weeks of massage therapy significantly improves WOMAC pain, stiffness, and physical function, and reduces medial muscle co-contraction. While it didn't impact knee loading or walking speed, these findings provide strong evidence for massage as an effective adjunct for knee OA symptoms and neuromuscular function.
items.limitation: 本研究未发现外部膝关节内收力矩、膝关节内收角冲量或步速有显著差异。
items.limitationEn: The study did not find significant differences in external knee adduction moment, knee adduction angular impulse, or walking speed.

items.title: What are the barriers and facilitators to engagement with physiotherapy among women experiencing adverse effects associated with menopause?
items.summary: A qualitative study of 12 women in the UK identified fatigue, cognitive issues, low self-efficacy, and negative language from healthcare professionals as barriers to physiotherapy engagement for menopause-related musculoskeletal pain, while direct inquiry about menopause, individualized treatment, and education were facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究强调了直接询问、个性化照护计划和健康教育对改善围绝经期女性肌骨疼痛患者理疗依从性的重要性。将其纳入你的初诊问诊表，尤其是在患者主诉疲劳或自我效能感低时。
items.titleZh: 围绝经期女性与物理治疗依从性的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国 12 名女性的定性研究发现，疲劳、认知问题、低自我效能感及医护人员负面语言是影响围绝经期肌骨疼痛女性物理治疗依从性的障碍，而直接询问更年期情况、个性化治疗和健康教育是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the importance of direct inquiry, individualized care plans, and health education in improving adherence to physiotherapy among perimenopausal women with MSK pain. Integrate these elements into your initial assessments, especially when patients report fatigue or low self-efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，为单中心定性研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and is a single-center qualitative study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: A pragmatic, decentralized trial of the home-based, autonomous InTandem® neurorehabilitation system: analyses of engagement, safety, and effectiveness from the OrcHESTRAS trial
items.summary: A decentralized trial of the InTandem® home-based neurorehabilitation system showed high engagement (81.9%) and significant improvements in 6MWT distance and TUG time in chronic stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: InTandem® 这种自主型居家神经康复系统在慢性卒中幸存者中展现了81.9%的高依从性，并显著改善了6MWT距离和TUG时间。这种可扩展的去中心化方法，为神经康复提供了很有前景的新途径。
items.titleZh: 基于家庭的自主InTandem®神经康复系统的一项实用型、去中心化试验：OrcHESTRAS试验中的参与度、安全性和有效性分析
items.titleEn: A pragmatic, decentralized trial of the home-based, autonomous InTandem® neurorehabilitation system: analyses of engagement, safety, and effectiveness from the OrcHESTRAS trial
items.summaryZh: 一项关于InTandem®居家神经康复系统的实用型试验显示，该系统在慢性卒中幸存者中实现了高参与度（81.9%），并显著改善了6分钟步行试验距离和计时起立行走试验时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: The autonomous, home-based InTandem® neurorehabilitation system achieved high engagement (81.9%) and significantly improved 6MWT distance and TUG time in chronic stroke survivors. This scalable, decentralized approach offers a promising new avenue for neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于12周内的参与度、安全性和有效性，进一步的长期结局数据将更有益。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on engagement, safety, and effectiveness over 12 weeks, and further long-term outcome data would be beneficial.

items.title: Remote Ischemic Conditioning Modulates Spinal Reflex Excitability in Healthy Young Adults: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot RCT involving 26 healthy young adults randomized to RIC or sham groups found that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) paired with balance training led to a greater reduction in Hslp/Mslp ratio (p=0.02) and improved balance performance (p=0.02) compared to sham, suggesting RIC may modulate spinal reflex excitability and enhance neuroplastic adaptations.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 提示远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练可能有助于调节脊髓反射兴奋性并改善健康年轻人的平衡表现。虽然只是初步证据，但其为未来在大规模试验中探索 RIC 在神经康复领域的应用奠定了基础。
items.titleZh: 远程缺血预处理调节健康年轻成人脊髓反射兴奋性的初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对26名健康年轻成人的试点RCT发现，远程缺血预处理 (RIC) 结合平衡训练的组别，其 Hslp/Mslp 比率（p=0.02）降低更多，平衡表现（p=0.02）改善更显著。这提示 RIC 可能调节脊髓反射兴奋性并增强神经可塑性适应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that remote ischemic conditioning (RIC) combined with balance training may help modulate spinal reflex excitability and improve balance performance in healthy young adults. Although preliminary, it lays the groundwork for future larger trials to explore RIC's application in neurological rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为试点随机对照试验，样本量较小且仅限于健康年轻成人，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size, limited to healthy young adults, so results should be interpreted with caution.

items.title: Rehabilitation to support leisure participation following stroke: a national survey of clinical practice in Australia.
items.summary: A national Australian survey of 131 allied health clinicians (35% physiotherapists) revealed that while most refer to guidelines for stroke rehabilitation, leisure participation assessments often lack specific scales, and common interventions target underlying impairments, with limited funding and training identified as barriers.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚的卒中康复实践中，休闲参与的评估和干预仍缺乏标准化，这提示您在临床实践中可能需要更具体的指导和资源，以更好地支持患者重返休闲活动。
items.titleZh: 支持卒中患者休闲参与的康复：一项澳大利亚临床实践全国调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对澳大利亚 131 名专职医疗临床医生（35% 为物理治疗师）的全国调查显示，尽管大多数人参考指南进行卒中康复，但休闲参与评估常缺乏具体量表，常见干预措施针对潜在功能障碍，且存在资金和培训不足的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: The assessment and intervention for leisure participation in stroke rehabilitation in Australia still lack standardization. This suggests you may need more specific guidance and resources in clinical practice to better support patients returning to leisure activities.
items.limitation: 研究依赖自我报告的在线调查，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on self-reported online surveys, which may introduce recall bias.

items.title: Acute neuromuscular and postural control responses to balance exercise with blood flow restriction in sedentary adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: In sedentary adults, adding BFR to a single balance exercise session did not provide additional acute benefits for postural control, proprioception, or functional performance compared to control or sham BFR.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，对久坐不动的成年人，单次平衡运动中额外加入血流限制（BFR）并未在姿势控制、本体感觉或功能表现方面带来额外的急性益处。这提示您，BFR可能需要重复训练才能在这一情境中显示出效果。
items.titleZh: 血流限制联合平衡运动对久坐成人急性神经肌肉和姿势控制反应：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Acute neuromuscular and postural control responses to balance exercise with blood flow restriction in sedentary adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 在久坐成人中，单次平衡运动中加入血流限制（BFR）未显示出比对照组或假BFR组在姿势控制、本体感觉或功能表现方面有额外的急性益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that adding blood flow restriction (BFR) to a single balance exercise session did not yield additional acute benefits in postural control, proprioception, or functional performance in sedentary adults. While not a practice-changing finding, it suggests that BFR might require repeated training to show effects in this context.
items.limitation: 所有结局均未观察到显著的组间×时间交互作用，未来研究应探讨重复BFR支持的平衡训练的效果。
items.limitationEn: No significant group × time interactions were observed for any outcome, and further studies should investigate the effects of repeated BFR-supported balance training.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The effectiveness of proprioceptive training for the prevention of ankle sprains in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 15 RCTs found proprioceptive training associated with a 34% lower relative occurrence of ankle injury in athletes, with moderate certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的系统综述和荟萃分析提供了强有力证据，表明本体感觉训练可将运动员踝关节损伤的相对发生率降低约34%。鉴于中等强度的证据确定性，您应将其整合到全面的损伤预防策略中，但最佳训练特征仍需进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练对运动员踝关节扭伤预防的有效性：一项系统评价与Meta分析
items.titleEn: The effectiveness of proprioceptive training for the prevention of ankle sprains in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summaryZh: 一项对15项随机对照试验的系统评价与Meta分析发现，本体感觉训练与运动员踝关节损伤发生率降低34%相关，证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides strong evidence that proprioceptive training reduces the relative occurrence of ankle injury in athletes by approximately 34%. Given the moderate certainty of evidence, you should integrate this into comprehensive injury prevention strategies, though optimal training characteristics warrant further investigation.
items.limitation: 最佳训练特征以及预防效果在不同运动、比赛水平和运动员群体中的普适性，需要进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: Optimal training characteristics and generalizability of the preventive effect across different sports, competition levels, and athlete populations require further investigation.

items.title: Individual variability and predictors of responsiveness in physical outcomes following multicomponent physical training in older adults
items.summary: In 314 older adults undergoing 12-month physical training, 46% showed high responsiveness across multiple outcomes, with multimorbidity, younger age, lower BMI, and higher resistance training adherence predicting better responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对314名老年人的研究揭示，长达12个月的体能训练项目存在显著的反应差异，其中46%的受试者在2-5项结果中表现出高反应。多病共存、更年轻、较低的BMI和更高的抗阻训练依从性是预测更好反应的因素，这为你在老年人群中制定个性化干预措施提供了重要见解。
items.titleZh: 老年人多组分体能训练后个体反应变异性和反应性预测因子
items.titleEn: Individual variability and predictors of responsiveness in physical outcomes following multicomponent physical training in older adults
items.summaryZh: 在314名接受12个月体能训练的老年人中，46%在多项结局指标上表现出高反应性，其中多重疾病、年龄较小、较低的BMI和较高的抗阻训练依从性是预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study in 314 older adults reveals significant variability in responses to a 12-month physical training program, with 46% showing a high response across multiple outcomes. Multimorbidity, younger age, lower BMI, and higher resistance training adherence predict better responses, offering important insights for tailoring interventions in geriatric populations.
items.limitation: 附肢瘦体重未观察到显著变化，且研究对象为社区居住的老年人。
items.limitationEn: No significant change was observed in appendicular lean mass, and the study population was community-dwelling older adults.

items.title: Evaluating ChatGPTs Responses to Chiropractic Patient Questions: A Comparative Study
items.summary: A study evaluating ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) responses to 30 chiropractic patient questions found them consistent with clinical practice guidelines, but with readability levels exceeding recommended patient education standards, and low inter-rater reliability among expert evaluators despite high mean scores.
items.curatedReason: GPT-5.2 在回答脊骨神经医学患者问题时，其内容与临床指南一致，但阅读难度较高。这提示您在考虑使用 AI 进行患者教育时，需要额外关注内容的易读性和个体化解读差异。
items.titleZh: 评估 ChatGPT 对脊骨神经医学患者问题的回答：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 ChatGPT (GPT-5.2) 回答 30 个脊骨神经医学患者问题的研究发现，其回答与临床实践指南一致，但阅读难度超出推荐的患者教育标准，且尽管专家评分均值较高，但评分者间可靠性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: GPT-5.2's responses to chiropractic patient questions are consistent with clinical guidelines but have a high readability level. This suggests that when considering AI for patient education, you need to pay extra attention to content readability and individual interpretation differences.
items.limitation: 研究只评估了ChatGPT在脊骨神经医学领域的表现，结果不一定能外推至物理治疗领域。
items.limitationEn: The study only evaluated ChatGPT's performance in chiropractic, and the results may not be generalizable to physical therapy.
